svg.text: Juice Shop · 20.1.1 · 8 components · 14 data flows · 4 trust boundaries (1 inferred) · 69 threats
acts on the pipeline, not on traffic

g.title: Trust boundary crossing: tb-1 External → C-02; tb-2 External → C-03; tb-3 External → C-06; tb-6 C-02 → External

df-002: Credentials sent to POST /rest/user/login; server validates via raw SQL and issues RS256 JWT or interim TOTP token (HTTPS) df-003: User submits TOTP code to POST /rest/2fa/verify accompanied by the RS256 interim token issued during password login (HTTPS) df-002 authentication: email + MD5-hashed password submitted in request body; no prior token required; evidence: routes/login.ts:34 df-002 access group: Credentials (MFA if enrolled); sequence; step 1 df-003 authentication: RS256 interim JWT (type: password_valid_needs_second_factor_token) from localStorage totp_tmp_token; evidence: routes/2fa.ts:20 df-003 access group: Credentials (MFA if enrolled); sequence; step 2

df-004: Authenticated REST API calls carrying RS256 JWT Bearer token for basket, orders, profile, and protected resources (HTTPS) df-005: Unauthenticated REST API calls to public endpoints: registration, feedback, product listing, challenge progress (HTTPS) df-004 authentication: RS256 JWT stored in localStorage; injected by request.interceptor.ts into Authorization header; evidence: frontend/src/app/Services/request.interceptor.ts:13, lib/insecurity.ts:52 df-004 access group: REST API calls; alternatives; step n/a df-005 authentication: no token required; routes accept unauthenticated requests by design; evidence: server.ts:408 df-005 access group: REST API calls; alternatives; step n/a

df-006: Socket.IO WebSocket for bidirectional challenge notifications and client-side XSS payload verification (WebSocket) df-006 authentication: no authentication check at connection; io.on('connection') accepts all clients without token validation; evidence: lib/startup/registerWebsocketEvents.ts:23

df-007: Sequelize ORM SQL queries over embedded SQLite covering users, products, orders, basket items, and feedback (SQLite) df-007 authentication: same-process embedded database; no network transport or credential exchange; evidence: models/index.ts:33

df-008: Login handler issues raw SQL SELECT against Users table to authenticate and hydrate the session (SQLite) df-008 authentication: same-process embedded database; no network transport or credential exchange; evidence: routes/login.ts:34

df-009: Express route handlers read and write product reviews and orders collections in the in-process MarsDB document store (MarsDB) df-009 authentication: same-process embedded store; no network transport or credential exchange; evidence: data/mongodb.ts:9

df-012: Chatbot route sends messages and tool definitions to an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint; API key from LLM_API_KEY env (HTTPS) df-012 authentication: LLM_API_KEY environment variable passed as Bearer in Authorization header via @ai-sdk/openai-compatible; evidence: routes/chat.ts:110
df-014: User input; evidence: frontend/src/app/app.guard.ts:48, frontend/src/app/app.routing.ts:81

End-user or attacker operating a web browser to interact with the Juice Shop SPA. May be anonymous or authenticated via session token.
g.text: web browser to interact with the

g.title: Google OAuth 2.0 authorization server used for social login. The frontend initiates an implicit-flow redirect to accounts.google.com; no server-side OAuth code path exists.
OpenAI-compatible LLM inference endpoint (default: local Ollama at localhost:11434/v1) used by the chatbot route. API key from LLM_API_KEY environment variable.
Application role with elevated rights, evidenced by its access check.

Google OAuth 2.0 df-010: Frontend redirects browser to Google OAuth with response_type=token and client_id; no CSRF state parameter included (HTTPS); implicit-flow redirect; access_token returned in URI fragment; no state parameter df-011: Google redirects browser back with access token in URL fragment; OAuth component extracts and processes the token (HTTPS); Completes the sign-in: the provider returns its result to the client's registered redirect URI df-013: OAuth profile request (HTTPS); The provider checks the OAuth access token sent with the request

C-01 · Angular SPA Frontend df-010: Frontend redirects browser to Google OAuth with response_type=token and client_id; no CSRF state parameter included (HTTPS); implicit-flow redirect; access_token returned in URI fragment; no state parameter df-011: Google redirects browser back with access token in URL fragment; OAuth component extracts and processes the token (HTTPS); Completes the sign-in: the provider returns its result to the client's registered redirect URI df-013: OAuth profile request (HTTPS); The provider checks the OAuth access token sent with the request
